meta.title: About Renee: remote studio based in Ankara
meta.description: Renee is the remote studio of Renee Design Lab at ODTÜ Teknokent, Ankara: over {{stat.brands}} brands, {{stat.identities}} identities, working during Swiss office hours.

h1: A studio in Ankara working for Switzerland.
lead: We are open about where we are based. What matters is availability, quality and clear processes.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Renee Design Lab is a design and advertising agency at ODTÜ Teknokent in Ankara. We have worked for over {{stat.brands}} brands and delivered more than {{stat.identities}} corporate identity projects, including for Bayer, Yataş Bedding and Medicana, as well as private schools and clinics.

Renee is our remote studio for the Swiss market. Our house typeface is Helvetica Neue, which traces back to Neue Haas Grotesk, created in 1957 in Münchenstein near Basel. Swiss typography has always shaped our work: grids, clarity, little decoration.

team.title: The team
team.text: Your project is handled by a fixed team with one point of contact.

steps.d: Mon–Fri {{hours.from}}–{{hours.to}} Swiss time. Time difference: 1 hour in summer, 2 in winter.
Figma, Asana or Trello, Slack or Teams, Google Workspace.
Short video calls at agreed times, replies within {{stat.response}} hours.

proof.title: Our own craft
proof.text: We publish our own brand guidelines, so you can see how we work. Our Turkish website shows the full portfolio.
